_comment: Beta's electronics bay is reconstructed open: the orange beta plate, the motors and the loom sit exposed between the armour walls with nothing over them. This is a lexan canopy over that bay — transparent, so the parts stay visible, and tucked down between the shell's side walls so the armour is still what protects it. Everything here is measured off an (x,z) -> highest-body-geometry map of modelBody rather than eyeballed. TOP: -0.122, the top of the orange plate, so the canopy never stands above it. WIDTH: 0.218 at the waist, which is as far out as it goes before meeting the armour wall's inner face at |x| 0.23. FRONT: z=0.060 at the sides, where the bay floor drops into a trough at -0.26, with a bite taken out of the middle (|x| < 0.10) because the hammer's gearbox stands up to -0.03 there and the arm swings through it. REAR: tapers to |x| 0.130 at z=-0.330, following the rim.
